siteCode.description: The canonical Site code the plan is keyed by (ADR 0035). The same value as the deprecated buildingId.

buildingId.description: DEPRECATED -- use siteCode. The legacy name of the plan key, kept with the SAME value as siteCode (same stored column) so existing consumers do not break. Removed only by a later, announced breaking ADR.

requiredHeads.description: ADDITIVE (ADR 0043 decision 4). The heads warehouse-planning published for this line's (siteCode, shiftId, pathId) in LabourPlanCommitted, shown next to the committed plannedHeads. Omitted when nothing was published. Never enforced: a line committing fewer heads than required is accepted.
